text: Meditation is also helpful, but for most people, I would still put inner-child reparenting, peer counseling, and body-based work first or make them primary meditation targets. Many people say they cannot meditate or have not gotten to that stage yet, and meditation without grounding in those approaches can easily be a road into spiritual bypassing.
reader: Someone whose partner’s moods drag them down, deciding who to talk to and how to calm their body.
